content:
**issue-998 PR 3: track lanes and the ? holding lane**

lib/lane-model.mjs groups the graph section's nodes by declared track
into lanes, each laid out with its own layout() call over its own
subgraph (a lane is a grouping, layout.mjs stays untouched). Undeclared
and unreadable nodes (track === null) land in the ? holding lane
instead — collapsed by default, paged at 24, carrying the exact
brain-graph/1 fence an author pastes to declare a track. Edges are
classified once over the whole graph into per-lane, cross-lane, or
unknown-node buckets before any lane's own layout runs, so a cross-lane
edge is reported in crossEdges (never dropped, never mistaken for an
edge to an unknown node) and drawn as a said list under the lanes —
lane boards do not share a coordinate space, so a line across rows was
out of scope. epicGrouping always says "not data yet (#967)" rather
than faking a kind/parent grouping.

app.js's renderCanvas became renderLanes: one row per lane (header with
count and mark/word × n state chips, then that lane's own SVG board),
then the ? holding lane last (show/hide toggle, the declare snippet in
a <pre>, 24 rows per page). drawnNodes() (R998-2's j/k traversal) now
walks every lane's board nodes, folding each lane's row index into a
large y offset so reading order stays correct across stacked rows
without teaching view-model.mjs about lanes; the holding lane's paged
rows carry no board coordinates and are excluded from traversal.

Branch feat/issue-998-pr3-lanes off 998e7369 (PR 2, under review).
Commits: fe590bb0 lib/lane-model.mjs + test — RED ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND
-> GREEN 12/12; mutation dropping the first holding-lane node after
sorting -> the exactly-once count test and the paging test red
(10/12); reverted. 834a1cba app.js/app.css — RED/GREEN: N/A, no DOM
harness (D9), verified by trace against lane-model.test.mjs's already-
covered contract; 44/44 across views-owned/app-source-guard/lane-
model/view-model/canvas-model. 5774365d tasks ticked + R998-3
scenarios detailed.

Full suite GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null npm test: 5624/0 (baseline
5612/0). npm run brain:repo:check green before every commit. Counted
diff 998e7369...HEAD (tests, openspec/changes/** excluded): 395/400.

Deviations from the design/tasks sketch, said: design.md's row for PR 3
sketches buildLaneModel's output with a single top-level width/height
alongside value — with lanes stacked as independent rows, there is no
one board those could describe, so width/height live per lane instead
(each lane's own layout() output), documented in lane-model.mjs's
header comment. The brief's signature named only {collapsedTracks};
holdingPage was added as a second option for the same reason: the
holding lane's own paging needed a place to live, and collapsedTracks
being a plain boolean Set had no room for it. canvas-model.mjs and its
test were left untouched — not in this PR's file list, and still a
valid standalone module even though app.js no longer imports it.

Carried: epic lanes reading node.kind/node.parent, the tracker chip,
and lane header slice counts are PR 8's work, gated on #967.
